column1: # Ukrainian grammar words. One line per word as written + part of speech:
# word <TAB> UD part of speech <TAB> senses separated by " | ".
# The file replaces Wiktionary's determiner, pronoun, preposition, conjunction,
# particle and auxiliary entries for every word listed here; nouns, verbs,
# adverbs and other content words stay (тому "therefore", треба "rite").
# Write the word with its stress mark, as the dump does (one-syllable words need
# none): lookups ignore the mark, and the reader sees it.
# A phrase with its own entry (так званий, крім того) is left to that entry,
# which lookups show first when the sentence contains it.
# A line with a content part of speech (тут ADV) replaces Wiktionary's entry
# of that part of speech for the word; X lines (endings) only add.
# Irregular forms a reader can't connect to their base get lines of their own
# (був "was", буде "will be", міг "could"): the protocol has no inflection tables.
# Written without a reader of the language (see profile.md): every line is the
# developer's, checked against the dump and the corpus, not by a Ukrainian reader.
# Wiktionary gives every personal pronoun one shared table (template l-self),
# so each form reached я, ти, він, вона, воно, ми, ви, вони and себе at once.
